title: make the base test command green
body: Outcome: the repository's own test command exits 0 on a clean checkout of the base.

Why: adoption found a red base: red base: the repository's own test command `.venv/bin/python -m pytest` exits 127 on the clean outside/py tree, so the Stop gate cannot pass it; make it pass (install the dependencies) and rerun. sh: line 1: .venv/bin/python: No such file or directory
